name: convoflo
description: Work in your Convoflo secure spaces from ChatGPT: find files, read and post messages, invite clients, and create and follow file, signature and payment requests.

interface.longDescription:
Convoflo is a secure client portal where firms and their clients exchange messages, files, file requests, signature requests and payment requests, in shared folders called secure spaces.

With Convoflo in ChatGPT you can:
- Find secure spaces, folders and files, and get a download link for a file.
- Read the messages your clients sent, and post messages and replies.
- Create secure spaces and folders, upload files and invite clients.
- Ask clients for documents with file requests, then approve or reject what they provide.
- Follow signature requests and remind signers.
- Create payment requests and follow their status.

ChatGPT acts with your own Convoflo permissions, and nothing can be deleted through Convoflo in ChatGPT. Messages, files and requests notify your clients only when you send them. A Convoflo account is required.
defaultPrompt: Which clients sent me files in Convoflo this week?
Which Convoflo signature requests are still waiting for a signature?
Summarize the latest messages my clients sent me in Convoflo.

positive.description: Lists the files clients added recently
positive.prompt: Which clients sent me files in Convoflo this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_recent_files and lists the files added by other people in the last 7 days, with the file name, who added it, when, and its secure space.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest messages my clients sent me in Convoflo.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_received_messages and summarizes the latest messages, grouped by secure space, with their author and date.

positive.description: Lists signature requests waiting for a signature
positive.prompt: Which Convoflo signature requests are still waiting for a signature?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_signature_requests with status sent and lists each request with its name, secure space and the signers who have not signed yet. Nothing is sent.

positive.description: Finds a file and returns a download link
positive.prompt: Find the engagement letter in Convoflo and give me a link to download it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_files with a search for the engagement letter, then get_file_download_link for the matching file, and gives the user the temporary download link.

positive.description: Asks a client for documents with a file request
positive.prompt: In my Convoflo secure space Acme Inc., ask the client for their 2025 bank statements and their 2025 invoices, due December 15.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Acme Inc. secure space with list_secure_spaces, creates a file request with the two items and the due date with create_file_request, then posts a message with the file request attached with post_message, after confirming with the user. The client is notified.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Montreal tomorrow?

negative.description: Writing task with no Convoflo data
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a junior accountant position.

negative.description: Domain question that needs no Convoflo action
negative.prompt: What is a T4 slip in Canada and when is it due?

publication.release_notes: First release: secure spaces, files, messages, and file, signature and payment requests in Convoflo.
